backupName: Space Call full storefront restore point

includes: inventory quantities and inventory item/location references

restorePolicy.code: Restore main from codeRestoreBranch only after reviewing changes.
restorePolicy.catalog: Use Shopify snapshot files to restore catalog/configuration values that were changed after this snapshot.
restorePolicy.inventory: Restore inventory only when the incident actually changed inventory. Do not overwrite legitimate sales-related stock movements.
restorePolicy.orders: Never delete or roll back orders created after the snapshot.
restorePolicy.customers: Never delete or roll back customers created after the snapshot.
restorePolicy.secrets: API tokens and environment secrets are not stored in this backup.
